Title: STRENGTH
Body: Adds 3 damage to the next {stacks} attacks.

Title: DOUBLE ATTACK
Body: The next {stacks} attack this character makes deals double damage.

Title: POISON
Body: Deals damage equal to {stacks} at the end of the turn.

Title: FROZEN
Body: Cannot act for {stacks} turns.

Title: SHIELD
Body: Absorbs the next {stacks} damage. Only lasts for this turn.

Title: BLOCK
Body: Reduces damage taken by 3 for {stacks} turns

Title: PARRY
Body: Negates all damage and reflects the damage back for the next {stacks} turns.

Title: ROOTED
Body: This character is unable to use move actions for {stacks} turns.

Title: DOUBLE SHIELD
Body: The next {stacks} Shields this character gains is doubled.

Title: DODGE
Body: Dodges the next attack and moves away. Lasts for the next {stacks} turns.

Title: WEAKEN
Body: Reduces the damage dealt by this character for the next {stacks} turns.

Title: TAUNT
Body: This character must move toward or attack the source of the Taunt for {stacks} turns.

Title: POISON BLADE
Body: For {stacks} more turns, every attack this character lands also applies {amount} Poison.

Title: STEALTH
Body: Enemies cannot target this character for {stacks} turns.

Title: VULNERABLE
Body: Increase the damage taken by 3 for the next {stacks} turns.

Title: EMPOWERED
Body: Multiplies {status} granted to all {targets} in range by {amount}.

Title: POTENT
Body: Adds {amount} to the potency of {status} for all {targets} in range.

Title: STANDING WARD
Body: Grants {amount} {status} to all {targets} in range {timing}.

Title: SUMMONED
Body: Will die in {stacks} turns.

Title: REGENERATION
Body: Heals {stacks} at the end of each of the carrier's turns, then decays by 1.

Title: LIFESTEAL
Body: For {stacks} more of the carrier's turns, every hit it lands also heals it for half the damage dealt.

Title: HONED
Body: All {targets} in range deal {amount} more damage.

Title: SHELTERED
Body: All {targets} in range take {amount} less damage.

Title: BOLSTERED
Body: Adds {amount} to {status} granted to all {targets} in range.

Title: WARDED
Body: Immune to one status at a time. Which one rotates at the end of each of this character's turns.

Title: THORNS
Body: Attackers take {stacks} damage whenever they hit this character. Does not wear off.

Title: SPLITTING
Body: Splits into two at half health, with the remaining health shared between them.

Title: ESCAPING
Body: Blinks to the far side of the board each time its health falls past another threshold.

Title: PILFERED
Body: Discards a card at random at the start of each of the next {stacks} turns.

Title: SAPPED
Body: 1 less energy each turn for {stacks} turns.

Title: INNATE
Body: Always in hand. Never enters the draw or discard pile.

Title: COOLDOWN
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after it is played.

Title: DORMANT
Body: Unusable for {magnitude} turns after you gain it.

Title: INTERRUPTIBLE
Body: Freezing this character while it is winding this up knocks the card out for {magnitude} turns.
